findings.claim: The GitHub package README retained the old incomplete permission contract.
findings.evidence: The package README mentioned only destination existence, explicit-key exclusion, and Windows support; it was updated with ACL verification, Linux tools, fail-closed behavior, rollback, and hard-termination recovery.

findings.claim: Failed-start listener cleanup could wait on accepted connections.
findings.evidence: Node server.close waits for connections; rollback now calls closeAllConnections after stopping acceptance.

findings.claim: A cleanup failure could replace the primary startup error or prevent artifact cleanup.
findings.evidence: A forced alias-removal failure logs a warning, preserves the later-alias registration error, and still removes the generated-secrets artifact.

findings.claim: Rollback cannot atomically unlink only a named inode through Node's portable filesystem API.
findings.evidence: The implementation verifies dev and ino immediately before unlink and preserves normal replacements, but a privileged concurrent replacement in the check-to-unlink window is not atomically excluded.

findings.claim: SIGKILL can leave the complete generated-secret artifact.
findings.evidence: SIGKILL cannot execute process cleanup; every documentation surface states the manual recovery requirement.

issue_candidates.title: Document residual check-to-unlink race in generated-secret rollback
issue_candidates.evidence: Node exposes path unlink but no portable unlink-if-inode operation; the current dev/ino verification narrows but cannot eliminate the race.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: The correction already preserves replacements observable before deletion and no stronger portable primitive is available in the current stack.

issue_candidates.title: SIGKILL residual generated-secret artifact
issue_candidates.evidence: Hard termination bypasses all cleanup while leaving a complete private artifact.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: No in-process implementation can clean up after SIGKILL; user recovery is documented.
